description: Curated, versioned reference collection for the doctor-only clinical assistant. Only sources listed here are retrievable. Ingest with: python tools/knowledge_ingest.py. Passages are stored verbatim in data/knowledge/passages/<id>.json with retrieval date and SHA-256.
curation_rules: Only official primary sources (regulator-approved drug labeling, government or professional-society guidelines).
Pin an exact version (DailyMed set id + SPL version, or URL + update date). Never ingest summaries written by a model.
Dosage and administration sections are excluded: the assistant never produces doses.
Record jurisdiction and intended population; a source outside the patient's jurisdiction is shown with that warning.
A source whose automatic retrieval fails stays listed with status 'blocked' and contributes no passages.

Israeli Ministry of Health medicines registry: doctor leaflets (עלון לרופא) are professional prescribing information; consumer leaflets (עלון לצרכן) are patient education and are never used as prescribing guidance.

Ministry pages on gov.il block automated access; they are added as manual_import sources (official URL verified by the curator, file saved from that URL in a browser) and stay 'not ingested' until imported.
